document.title: Eval: keep Spark contributor defaults — Ember is not on the subscription and costs more on output
document.summary: One docs paragraph records why Ember stays off the eval defaults.
document.why: Evals run on the Muse Code subscription by default, so a cheaper lower-tier model only helps when it runs on that login and costs less per case.

commits.body:
Ember has no contributor variant, is absent from the Muse Code
subscription login, and costs more per output token on the Model API.
Grader agreement was near parity in rescore checks. Keep defaults.
